text: かってる　ポケモンは　１００ぴきを　こえとる！

structure.jp: かってる　ポケモンは

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: かってる　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing tells you which thing it is. かってる is the shortened かっている. かってる　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon I keep'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: とる is the old-man and western-dialect form of ている, which shows a state that holds now. こえとる = 'has gone over, is more than'.
